KqlQuery:
AppEvents 
| extend 
FieldName = Properties.DataAssetPropertyName,
ActionSource = Properties.ActionSource, 
ErrorMessage = Properties.ErrorMessage, 
ErrorType = Properties.ErrorType
| where Name == 'ValidationError'
| summarize
 Count = count()
by 
tostring(FieldName),
tostring(ErrorType),
tostring(ErrorMessage),
tostring(ActionSource)
| order by Count desc
